title: Model-variant fallback coordinator and customer communication pathway for mixed-deployment rollouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: When heterogeneous deployments (hosted, Dedicated, Private) receive staggered model updates we occasionally observe asymmetric regressions: a model variant passes synthetic and internal canaries but degrades on customer slices due to KV cache mismatch, tokenization edge cases, or hardware-specific kernel divergences. This ticket defines an automated fallback coordinator plus a customer-facing escalation pathway that: (1) detects tenant-scoped functional regressions quickly, (2) orchestrates variant fallback with KV cache reconciliation and traffic slicing, and (3) surfaces concise, actionable communications to affected customers and account teams.
acceptance_criteria: Automated detector flags tenant-scoped quality regressions within 5 minutes of deviation and annotates likely root cause (kvcache|tokenization|kernel)
Fallback coordinator can route affected tenant traffic to a pinned stable variant across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private with <2s controller latency and no dropped requests
KV cache reconciliation procedure documented and runnable as a safe rollback step for Dedicated/Private environments
Customer-facing templated status and recommended mitigation steps exist and are validated with Solutions Engineering
End-to-end test that simulates a variant regression and verifies traffic routing, metrics update, and customer notification completes in CI
playbook_steps: Detection: enrich canary rules with tenant-sliced MRR and semantic-quality metrics; if threshold breached create incident ticket and mark tenants impacted
Isolation: pin traffic for impacted tenant to 'diagnostic' slice (10% mirror) while continuing majority traffic on baseline
Decision: fallback-coordinator evaluates variant compatibility matrix and chooses best fallback based on latency, cost, and previously observed quality for the tenant
Execute: perform traffic switch with staged ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and run KV cache reconciliation for Dedicated/Private when switching across model families
Verify: run sampled prompts from the tenant's eval set through both variants and compare score distribution; if regression fixed, close incident; otherwise escalate to live hotpatch flow
Communicate: send templated customer communication including scope, mitigation applied, expected ETA, and recommended application-side mitigations if any
progress_updates: 2026-03-01 - Initial triage: incident replayed locally; observed KV cache staleness when switching between quantized and non-quantized variants. Assigned to Marco Ruiz.

2026-03-03 - Design review: agreed on a coordinator service that uses a compatibility matrix and stores per-tenant last-good-variant. Decided to keep controller stateless and use consistent KV store for pinned mappings.
2026-03-05 - Prototype: fallback coordinator v0 routes traffic in staging; observed 1.3s extra controller overhead — optimized batching of routing ops to remove tail latency.
2026-03-07 - PR opened: runtime#5128 adds routing API, new metrics (tenant_regression_count, fallback_activations_total) and CLI to trigger KV reconciliation; in review by infra and SRE.
2026-03-09 - QA: added end-to-end test that simulates a tokenization mismatch causing hallucination; test failed initially due to missing token normalization; added normalizer and re-ran.
2026-03-10 - Prep: templates for customer comms drafted and approved by Solutions Engineering; executing dedicated environment dry-run on customer-sim tenant pool
review_feedback: SRE (L. Patel): add circuit-breaker on routing calls and metrics for fallback rollbacks per-hour
Security (R. Owens): confirm that pinned mappings in KV store are encrypted at rest; suggested KMS envelope for rotation
Design (E. Morales): recommend including a 'rollback reason' enum to capture kvcache|quantization|tokenization|kernel for downstream analytics
Solutions Eng (M. Singh): customer comms should include a single actionable step for integrators (flush local caches / increase prompt context window)
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Cross-variant KV cache reconciliation may induce transient latency spikes in Dedicated/Private clusters. Mitigation: perform reconciliation in background with request-level graceful degradation and maintain a short-lived prefix cache for reads.
Risk: Incorrect fallback choice could amplify regression for multi-tenant Dedicated hosts. Mitigation: regionally constrained fallback and immediate automated rollback if error-rate > 2x baseline

Risk: Customers on air-gapped Private installs require manual approval for changes. Mitigation: provide a guided checklist + one-click downloadable patch that their ops can apply with checksum verification
next_actions: Address SRE feedback: add circuit-breaker and add metrics (2 points)
Merge runtime#5128 after approvals and promote to canary ring A for 24h with synthetic and tenant-slice monitors
Run Dedicated dry-run with KV reconciliation against 3 internal tenant replicas and validate latency impact < 200ms p95
Coordinate with Customer Success to schedule 1:1 briefing for any customers flagged as impacted in the past 30 days
